verses.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
verses.sm: Ua toeaina le tupu o Tavita, ua tele ona tausaga; ua latou ufitia o ia i ie, a e le mafanafana ai o ia.

verses.en: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ana auauna ia te ia, Seʻi saili mai se teine taupou mo lo matou alii ie tupu, ina ia tu o ia i luma o le tupu, ma tausi ia te ia; ia taoto foi o ia i lou fatafata, ina ia mafanafana ai lo matou alii le tupu.

verses.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.sm: Ona latou sailiili ai lea i itu uma o Isaraelu o se teine lalelei; ua latou maua Apiseka le Sunema, ona latou aumaia lea o ia i le tupu.

verses.en: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
verses.sm: O le teine matua lalelei lava ia, na ia tausia foi le tupu, ma auauna ia te ia; a e lei iloa o ia e le tupu.

verses.en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.sm: O Atonia, o le tama tane a Akita, ua faamaualuga o ia, ua faapea, Ou te fai ma tupu. Ua ia faia foi mona o le nofoa faataavalevale, ma è tietie i solofanua, ma tagata e toalimagafulu e taufetuli i ona luma,

verses.en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
verses.sm: E lei faatigaina o ia e lona tama talu ina tupu mai, i lona fai atu, Se a le mea ua e faapea ai? O ja foi ua aulelei lava lona tino; na fanaua o ia o le tua o ia o Apisaloma.

verses.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
verses.sm: Ua latou fetautalatalai foi ma loapo le tama a Seruia, ma Aviata le faitaulaga; ua la fesoasoani ma mulimuii atu ia Atonia.

verses.en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.sm: A o Satoka le faitaulaga, ma Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata, ma Natano le perofeta, ma Semi, ma Rei, ma le au toa, O e sa ia Tavita, ua le i ai i latou ia Atonia.

verses.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:
verses.sm: ọ Ua fafasi foi e Atonia o mamoe, ma povi, ma manu pepeti, e lata ane i le maa o Soelete, e lata ane i Enerokelu, ua ia talaʻi atu ai Ona uso uma, O atalii o le tupu, ma tagata o Iuta uma lava, O auauna a le tupu;

verses.en: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
verses.sm: a o Natano le perofeta, ma Penaia, ma le au toa, atoa ma Solomona lona uso ua ia le talaʻiina.

verses.en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Natano ia Patesepa le tina o Solomona, ua faapea atu, Ua e le faalogo ea o loo fai ma tupu Atonia le tama tane a Akita, a e le o silafia e lo tatou alii o Tavita?

verses.en: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
verses.sm: O lenei, ina sau ia, sou faatonu atu ia te oe, ina ia faaola oe ia te oe, ma lau tama o Solomona.

verses.en: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
verses.sm: Alu ia oe, ma e ulufale atu i le tupu o Tavita, ma e fai atu i ai, Le alii e, le tupu, na e le tauto mai ea ia te au lau auauna fafine, ua faapea mai, E moni, e fai lau tama o Solomona ma tupu pe a mavae atu aʻu, e tietie foi O ia i loʻu nofoalii; se a foi le mea ua fai ai Atonia ma tupu?

verses.en: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
verses.sm: Faauta mai ia, a O tautalatala ai oulua ma le tupu ou, te alu atu foi e mulimuli ia te oe, ma ou faamaonia au upu.

verses.en: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea o Patesepa i le tupu i lona potu, ua toeaina lava le tupu; ua auauna foi Apiseka le Sunema i le tupu.

verses.en: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
verses.sm: Ona punou ai lea o Patesepa, ma ifo atu i le tupu. Ona fai mai lea o le tupu, Se a ea lou manao?

verses.en: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia ia te ia, Le alii e, na e tauto i le ALII lou Atua i lau auauna fafine, na faapea mai, E moni, e fai lau tama o Solomona ma tupu pe a mavae atu au, e tietie foi o ia i loʻu nofoalii.

verses.en: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
verses.sm: O lenei, faauta, o loo fai ma tupu Atonia, a o oe le alii e, le tupu, ua e le silafia.

verses.en: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
verses.sm: Ua fafasi foi e ia o povi, ma manu pepeti, ma mamoe e tele lava, ua ia tala‘iina foi o atalii uma lava o le tupu, ma Aviata le faitaulaga, ma Ioapo le pule i ‘au; a o Solomona lau auauna ua ia le tala‘iima.

verses.en: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
verses.sm: A o oe le alii e, le tupu, o loo faasagasaga Isaraelu uma ia te Oe, ina ia e faasino mai ia te i latou po o ai e tietie i le nofoalii o loʻu alii le tupu pe a mavae atu o ia.

verses.en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
verses.sm: A leai, ona ta‘uagasalaina lea o i maua ma la‘u tama o Solomona, pe a taoto lo‘u alii le tupu faatasi ma ona tama.

verses.en: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
verses.sm: Faauta, o tautalatala i laua ma le tupu, ua ulufale atu Natano le perofeta.

verses.en: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
verses.sm: Ona latou ta‘u atu lea i le tupu, ua faapea atu, Faauta, o Natano le perofeta. Ua ulufale atu o ia i luma o le tupu, ona ifo toele lea o ia i luma o le tupu.

verses.en: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Natano, Le alii e, le tupu, po ua e fetalaia ea, E fai Atonia ma tupu pe a mavae atu aʻu, e tietie foi o ia i loʻu nofoalii?

verses.en: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
verses.sm: Aua ua alu ifo o ia i le aso nei, ma ua fafasi i povi, ma manu pepeti, ma mamoe e tele lava; ua tala‘iina foi e ia o atalii uma o le tupu, ma e avea “au, ma Aviata le faitaulaga; faauta foi, ua latou aai ma feinu i ona luma, ma ua faapea ane, Ia soifua le tupu o Atonia.

verses.en: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
verses.sm: A o aʻu, o au nei lau auauna, ma Satoka le faitaulaga, o Penaia foi le atalii o Ieoiata, ma lau auauna © Solomona ua ia le tala‘iina.

verses.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
verses.sm: Po ua faia ea lenei mea e loʻu alii le tupu, a e te lei faailoa mai i lau auauna po o ai e tietie i le nofoalii o loʻu alii le tupu pe a mavae atu o ia?

verses.en: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o le tupu o Tavita, ua faapea mai, Ina valaau atu ia ia Patesepa e sau ia te au. Ona sau lea o ia i luma o le tupu, ua tu foi i luma o le tupu.

verses.en: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
verses.sm: Ona tauto lea o le tupu, ua faapea mai, O loo soifua le An, o le na faaolaina a'u i puapuaga uma lava,

verses.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
verses.sm: e faapei ona ou tauto ia te oe i le ALI le Atua o Isaraelu, ua faapea atu, E moni, e fai lau tama o Solotona ma tupu pe a mavae atu aʻu, e tietie foi o ia i loʻu nofoalii e sui aʻi aʻu, e faapea lava ona ou faia i le aso nei.

verses.en: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
verses.sm: Ona punou lea o Patesepa i le eleele, ua ifo o ia i le tupu, ua faapea atu, Ia soifua e faavavau loʻu alii le tupu o Tavita.

verses.en: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o le tupu o Tavita, Ina valaau atu ia ia Satoka le faitaulaga, ma Natano le perofeta, ma Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata. Ona latou o mai lea i luma o le tupu.

verses.en: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu ia te i latou, Ina o ia outou atoa ma auauna a lo outou alii, ma faatietie ia Solomona loʻu atalii i lau lava falata, ma tàʻitaʻi ifo ia te ia i Kiona;

verses.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
verses.sm: ma ia faauuina o ia i lea mea e Satoka le faitaulaga, ma Natano le perofeta, e fai ma tupu ia Isaraelu; ia outou ili foi le pu, ma fai atu, Ia soifua le tupu o Solomona.

verses.en: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
verses.sm: Ona outou o ae lea o mulimuli ia te ia, ina ia sau O ia ta tietie i loʻu nofoalii; aua e fai o ia ma tupu e sui aʻi aʻu; ua ou tofia foi o ia e fai ma tai'ta'i ia Isaraelu atoa foi ma Iuta.

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata 11e tupu, ua faapea atu, Amene; ia faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII le Atua o loʻu alii le tupu.

verses.en: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
verses.sm: E faapei ona i ai o le ALII i loʻu alii le tupu, ia faapea lava ona i ai o ia ia Solomona, ma faasili ona mamalu o lona nofoalii i le nofoalii o loʻu alii le tupu o Tavita.

verses.en: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.sm: Ona o ifo lea o Satoka le faitaulaga, ma Natano le perofeta, ma Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata, ma le au Kereti, ma le au Peleti, ma latou faatietie ia Solomona i le falata a le tupu o Tavita, ma latou taʻitaʻi ia te ia i Kiona.

verses.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
verses.sm: Ona ave lea e Satoka le faitaulaga se fagu nifo o suauu ai le fale fetafai, ma faauu aʻi ia Solomona. Ona latou ilia lea o le pu; ua fai atu le nuu uma, Ia soifua le tupu o Solomona.

verses.en: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
verses.sm: Ona o ae lea o le nuu uma o mulimuli atu ia te ia, ua latou ilia foi fagufagu, ma latou olioli lava ma le olioli tele, ua mavae le laueleele i lo latou alalaga.

verses.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
verses.sm: Ua lagona ai e Atonia ma i latou uma sa talaʻiina e ia, ina ua uma ona latou aai. Ua lagona foi e Ioapo le leo o le pu, ona faapea lea o ia, Po o le a ea lena vavao o le aai ua vevesi?

verses.en: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
verses.sm: Faauta, o tautala o ia ua sau Ionatana le atalii o Aviata le faitaulaga; ona fai atu lea o Atonia ia te ia, Sau ia, aua o oe O le tagata amio lelei, ma ua e aumaia tala lelei.

verses.en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea o Ionatana ia Atonia, ua faapea mai, E moni, o lo tatou alii o le tupu o Tavita, ua na faia lava Solomona ma tupu.

verses.en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
verses.sm: Ua aauina foi faatasi ma ia e le tupu, o Satoka le faitaulaga, ma Natano le perofeta, ma Penaia le atalii o Ieoiata, ma le au Kereti, ma le au Peleti, ua latou faatietie foi ia Solomona i le falata a le tupu;

verses.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
verses.sm: ua faauuina-foi o ia i Kiona e Satoka le faitaulaga ma Natano le perofeta e fai ma tupu; ua latou O ae ai ma le olioli, ua vevesi ai foi le aai. O le vavao lea ua outou faalogo atu i ai.

verses.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.sm: O loo tietie foi Solomona i le nofoalii o le malo.

verses.en: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
verses.sm: I le ma lea foi, ua o atu auauna a le tupu e faamanuia atu i lo tatou alii le tupu o Tavita, ua faapea atu, Ia faasili e le Atua o le suafa o Solomona i lou suafa, ma ia faasili lona nofoalii i lou nofoalii. Ona ifo lea o le tupu i lona moega.

verses.en: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai foi le tupu, ua faapea mai, Ia faafetaia le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu, o le ua foaiina mai i le aso nei o le tasi e tietie i loʻu nofoalii, o loo vaai atu i ai oʻu mata.

verses.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
verses.sm: Ona matatau ai lea o i latou uma e na tala‘iina o e sa i ai ma Atonia, ma ua latou tutù ua latou taitasi ma alu i lona ala.

verses.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
verses.sm: Ua mata‘u foi Atonia ona o Solomona, ona tulai lea o ia ma alu, ma tago atu i nifo o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
verses.sm: Ua ta‘uina mai foi ia Solomona ua faapea mai, Faauta, ua mataʻu Atonia i le tupu o Solomona; faauta foi, ua tago atu o ia i nifo o le fata faitaulaga, ua faapea mai o ia, Ia tauto mai le tupu o Solomona ia te au i le aso nei na te le fasiotia lana auauna i le pelu.

verses.en: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Solomona, Afai e amio lelei o ia e le pati sona lauulu i le eleele; a e afai e iloa se leaga ia te ia, e oti ia.

verses.en: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
verses.sm: Ona aauina atu lea nisi e le tupu o Solomona; ua latou ta‘ita‘i mai foi ia te ia ai le fata faitaulaga. Ona sau lea o ia, ma ifo mai i le tupu o Solomona; ona fai atu lea o
